d:
Long, wavy hair in a muted olive-green shade with long bangs framing the face. Droopy, shy eyes in a pale lime shade. Apparent age of a young teenager with a timid expression. Small, slight build. A white and blue sailor-style school uniform with a short pleated skirt and a red necktie. Small, rounded white animal ears atop the head and a short, fluffy white tail.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
